purpose: City-specific discovery of official cadastral parcel sources for Apartadó, Colombia; claims are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Apartadó

queries.query: Apartadó Colombia official cadastral parcel map GIS catastro IGAC Alcaldía
queries.result: Official search results identified IGAC's national cadastral open-data/service pages and a first-party Antioquia cadastral ArcGIS service whose item metadata is specifically titled cartografía básica predial para el municipio de Apartadó.

queries.query: Catastro Antioquia datos abiertos predios Apartadó servicio geográfico
queries.result: Spanish-language first-party results identified the Gobernación de Antioquia / Gerencia de Catastro as cadastral manager for Apartadó and exposed the public M045 service with Predios_Urbanos and Predios_Rurales polygon layers.

officialSources.observation: First-party/public service item metadata describes M045 as cartografía básica predial para el municipio de Apartadó and tags it with catastro Antioquia/Apartadó.
Public Predios_Urbanos polygon layer in the Apartadó service.
Public Predios_Rurales polygon layer in the Apartadó service.
Gobernación de Antioquia states its Gerencia de Catastro is cadastral manager for all Antioquia municipalities except a named exclusion list that does not include Apartadó.
IGAC national cadastral open-data context; not treated as local-custodian evidence.

requests.outcome: Succeeded; service metadata exposed layers ZHFisica_urbano, ZHEconomica_urbano, Predios_Urbanos (9), Predios_Rurales (10), and other planning layers; service CRS EPSG:9377.

Succeeded; Predios_Urbanos is esriGeometryPolygon, maxRecordCount 1000, service extent EPSG:9377; inspected fields included OBJECTID, TERRENO_CODIGO, LOCAL_ID, ESPACIO_DE_NOMBRES, GLOBALID and other source fields.

Succeeded; safe exact WUP-point intersects query using the exact unshifted point in EPSG:4326, outFields=OBJECTID,TERRENO_CODIGO,LOCAL_ID,ESPACIO_DE_NOMBRES, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326 returned one polygon.
Succeeded; IGAC national service exposed R_TERRENO and U_TERRENO polygon layers in EPSG:4686.
Succeeded; separate IGAC U_TERRENO exact-point count query returned count 0. This is a bounded miss only and is not evidence of citywide absence.
Timed out after 30 seconds on a bounded envelope count attempt; no retry/bypass and no absence inference.
Timed out during metadata request after 30 seconds; no inference.

registryBasis: The Gobernación de Antioquia / Gerencia de Catastro is evidenced as the cadastral manager for Apartadó, and its public M045 ArcGIS service is explicitly titled for Apartadó and exposes public urban and rural parcel polygon layers.

source.crs: EPSG:9377 source; returned sample reprojected by service to EPSG:4326

nativeSchema.stableIdentityStatus: TERRENO_CODIGO is retained as the canonical native parcel identity; it is a source-provided cadastral code, not an internal row number.
safeAllowlist: source layer and bounded query metadata
nativeSchema.retainedPropertiesPolicy: The retained GeoJSON has exactly one property, id, mapped from TERRENO_CODIGO; raw source attributes are not retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Apartadó public M045 cadastral map service, with urban and rural parcel layers.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public service metadata, schema/CRS, exact WUP-point query, and one safe polygon response verified.

remainingUncertainty: The exact WUP point returned one urban polygon from the public service, but no citywide enumeration or completeness test was performed. Rural coverage and municipal boundary completeness were not independently enumerated. The IGAC national service gave a separate exact-point miss and one envelope request timed out; these results do not contradict the local service response.
